fr|en|Événement inattendu qui survient p: Unexpected event that occurs by chance. —It is usually taken as a bad thing, when it is not accompanied by any epithet which determines its meaning in a good way.
fr|en|Événement soudain, qui, bouleversa: Sudden event, which, disrupting the course of things, brings destruction, ruin, death.
